column1: # Terraform root modules against the local AWS emulator (ADR-0018).
# Columns (tab-separated): root, plan, apply, replan, destroy, gaps.
# replan=ok means a second plan after apply showed no changes.
# gaps names what the emulator lacks; none of them is a defect in the code.

column6: S3 Control ListTagsForResource does not return bucket tags, so tags show as a change
Config recorder resource-type enum lacks AWS::EKS::Nodegroup; EC2 instance metadata defaults not implemented; Budgets DescribeSubscribersForNotification returns 500
no SSM public parameter for the EKS optimized AMI release version (read by the upstream EKS module during plan)
EKS pod identity association needs the cluster from terraform/envs/eks, which cannot be planned here
SSO Admin ListTagsForResource not implemented (500), so apply cannot read back the tagged permission sets and destroy cannot refresh them
Organizations EnableAWSServiceAccess rejects malware-protection.guardduty.amazonaws.com; Budgets DescribeSubscribersForNotification returns 500
Budgets DescribeSubscribersForNotification returns 500 (the same gap as account-baseline), so apply cannot read back the alerts and destroy cannot find the budget
AWS managed policy AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations missing; Access Analyzer CreateAnalyzer, GuardDuty organization configuration and Security Hub UpdateSecurityHubConfiguration not implemented
